headline: LOOP CLEAN, STEERING BUDGET BREATHING (2026-09-16): 11 PRs merged across the night and 0 left open — #325 (park-signal harvest) and #331 (session board) landed last. The board is now a HARD RULE in CLAUDE.md §0: claim your subsystem before you touch anything, release when you stop. It only fit because the 25KB steering budget went from 13 bytes spare to 273, by moving PR roll-calls and metric snapshots to DONE-LOG.md. lilac finally has a main branch — it had none, plus nine mutually disjoint root histories, so nothing could ever merge into anything.
